test_cases.title: Clearing a required field on an existing record blocks the save and shows its message
acs: DERIVED: Client validators block saving when a required field is cleared on existing records - 20 fields (data/field-validation.json, survey 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
The record is the first one in its list. Only one field is cleared per execution and the page is left without a successful save.
The Lab Code field on Participant Details posts back when cleared and is not covered.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 20 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Follow the click path in the current row to the record.
steps.expected: The record form opens with its values.

steps.action: Clear the field named in the row.

steps.expected: The page stays on the form and nothing is saved.
The message in the row is shown.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from read-only surveys of the running app and the page source; confirm the headings and messages are the intended behaviour.
